knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A split mat is removed from use, a blocked exit is cleared before participants arrive, and both items are recorded.
Hornsby's commercial fitness permit names yoga and tai chi. Other councils' coverage of yoga is not set out in this course.
The lesson says a class space needs room for each participant, a clear path to the exit, and a firm floor.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate inspect a simulated room, clear a blocked exit, and record the set-up before the class
Assessor observes the candidate inspect each mat and prop, and remove a simulated damaged item from use with a record
Assessor checks that the candidate states the council permit position for a named council, with the source, and leaves other councils out
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Class set-up record for the simulated class
Equipment inspection record with the removed item and date
Written statement of the council permit position with the source
stopWorkCriteria: The class starts with an exit blocked
A damaged mat, prop or piece of equipment is used
A class is run on public land without a checked permit
